value.summary: Management has demonstrated strong credibility by delivering on store expansion targets and maintaining revenue growth despite significant external headwinds like election restrictions and extreme weather. While some short-term margin volatility exists due to forex and strategic discounting, their long-term vision for premiumization and lifestyle diversification remains consistent.

promises.quote: In FY '25, we intend to add approximately 20 boutiques . We intend to keep growing our physical network
promises.actual_delivered: Successfully inaugurated 14 new boutiques in FY25 and reached a count of 73 boutiques, as reported in the May 2025 transcript (page 3).
promises.reasoning: The company added 14 stores, falling short of the 20-store target due to construction delays caused by GRAP IV restrictions in Delhi NCR.

promises.quote: We now plan to open a second service centre in Bengaluru, which will be operational in the second quarter of this year
promises.promised: Open a second service centre in Bengaluru by Q2 FY25.
promises.actual_delivered: The Nov 2024 transcript (page 9) confirms the second service center in South India was opening in that quarter to double capacity.
promises.reasoning: The opening was pushed from Q2 to the following quarter.

promises.quote: the new boutique will become fully operational in January or February, marking our formal entry into the extremely lucrative international branded jewellery segment.
promises.promised: First Messika boutique to be fully operational in Jan/Feb 2025.
promises.actual_delivered: The May 2025 transcript (page 3) confirms the launch of the first Messika boutique occurred on 14th May 2025.
promises.reasoning: The launch occurred in May 2025, missing the Feb 2025 target date.

promises.quote: The launch in India will be in January. On 10 th of January there will be a launch at the Swiss embassy.
promises.promised: Favre Leuba India launch in January 2025.
promises.actual_delivered: The May 2025 transcript (page 14) confirms the brand was launched and is present in about 40 or 45 locations.
promises.reasoning: The brand was successfully launched and distributed across the network as planned.

guidance.target: Cross 100 boutiques during the current financial year (FY26).
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain on track to be able to cross 100 boutiques during the current financial year.
I would like to reiterate our long-term vision, which was stated when we went public to grow our revenue 10x over 10 years.

guidance.target: Cover approximately 50% of foreign currency exposure through forward contracts.
guidance.quote: We have now implemented a prudent hedging strategy covering approximately 50% of our foreign currency exposure through forward contracts.

guidance.target: Target 8 to 10 boutiques of Messika in the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: we hope to open 8 to 10 boutiques more of Messika in the next 5 years.

guidance.target: Target an 8X to 10X increase in the Rimowa business over the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: In my opinion over the next 5 years, we are going to at least target an 8X to 10X increase in the business of just Rimowa itself.

bull.point: Strong recovery in sales momentum following temporary disruptions, with record growth in specific months.
bull.quote: In October we had a record month with a 47% year -on-year growth.

bull.point: Successful premiumization strategy evidenced by rising Average Selling Prices (ASP).
bull.quote: Our ASP for H1 FY25 stood at Rs. 2,15,952 as compared to Rs 1.87 lakhs in H1 FY24.

bull.point: High growth in the pre-owned watch segment, which offers a competitive moat through organized certification.
bull.quote: Our pre -owned segment also continues to demonstrate strong traction, growing at over 30% year-on-year.

bear.point: Significant inventory buildup and working capital pressure due to aggressive store expansion and pre-ordering.
bear.quote: the inventory moved from INR 440 crores on 31st March 2024 to INR593 crores as on 31st March 2025.

bear.point: Vulnerability to foreign exchange fluctuations, specifically the CHF-INR rate, impacting EBITDA margins.
bear.quote: This movement had a notable impact on our financial results resulting in a FOREX loss of approximately Rs 4.65 crores.
